name: Mount Tabor
line: Mount Tabor is a lone, rounded mountain in northern Israel, where Barak gathered Israel's army before a great victory over Sisera, and a place the Bible uses to praise God.

moments.title: Barak Goes to Tabor
moments.text: Deborah tells Barak that the LORD commands him to march to Mount Tabor with ten thousand men of Naphtali and Zebulun. The LORD promises to hand Sisera over to him.

moments.title: Victory Over Sisera
moments.text: Sisera hears that Barak has gone up Mount Tabor and gathers his chariots. Deborah tells Barak the day has come, so he goes down with ten thousand men, and the LORD defeats Sisera's whole army.

moments.title: Tabor Shouts for Joy
moments.text: In a poem of praise, the psalmist says God created north and south. Tabor and Hermon are pictured shouting for joy at His name.
